formal_statement: For finite I, 0 ≤ pᵢ ≤ 1, λ ≥ 0, and Σᵢ mᵢpᵢ ≤ b: Σᵢ[(1-pᵢ)aᵢ+pᵢtᵢ] ≥ Σᵢaᵢ - λb - Σᵢ max(0,aᵢ-tᵢ-λmᵢ).

in.rationale: The two-population proof substitutes honest fiber masses and attack event masses into this exact algebraic helper, rather than invoking the one-population dual_certificate theorem.
